what_happened: The launch aborted on the first candidate (lambda_R = 0.0) during live environment construction, before any training step. The driver reused configure_exp2c_live_environment, which hardcodes EXP2C's frozen seed ranges (train 8700001..8700320, dev 8800001..8800192). SPPPO's audited blocks are different, so the guard raised 'EXP2B seed escaped frozen block: 10200001'.
the_guard_worked: the seed-block guard refused before a step was spent. It also enforces the 16/0/0/16 cell layout and per-env z/pole mapping, which independently complements the batch-level pole consistency check in RankingRunner.

SECOND_AND_MORE_SERIOUS_DEFECT.found: while diagnosing the crash, not by the crash itself
SECOND_AND_MORE_SERIOUS_DEFECT.defect: the driver TRAINED all five candidates on seed 10200001 -- the DEVELOPMENT block -- and read Delta_A/Delta_B from training-time telemetry. Selection would then have been in-sample on the very block reserved for choosing lambda_R.
SECOND_AND_MORE_SERIOUS_DEFECT.why_it_matters: training all five candidates on the development block and selecting from those same trajectories makes the lambda choice in-sample and defeats the purpose of reserving a development block at all.
SECOND_AND_MORE_SERIOUS_DEFECT.PI_ruling: train on 10100001..10100032; evaluate terminal checkpoints on 10200001..10200032; the selector consumes ONLY the separate development evaluation. Training-time telemetry may remain diagnostic but is not the selection quantity. The 98,304-step per-candidate TRAINING budget is unchanged.

why_preserved_not_deleted: the first driver wiring was wrong on a scientific axis, not merely a path. Deleting the attempt would erase the fact that the train/selection split was initially conflated.
successor: the corrected launch regenerates SWEEP_CONTRACT.json from scratch
